attck_mappings.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
attck_mappings.justification: Recovered 202.95.11.173 (XOR key 0x61) by brute-forcing every possible single-byte XOR key against the binary and requiring a clean null-padded boundary around the match (not just a coincidental decode). A network address stored obfuscated like this is unusable to the malware until it reverses the same encoding at runtime -- direct evidence of Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information (T1140).
